caption: The video showcases a close-up studio view of three faceted gemstones positioned over a glossy pale-blue surface, framed by large out-of-focus blue, red and clear gem shapes at the edges. A blue gem, a pink-magenta gem and a pale lavender gem form a loose triangle at the center, each with a soft mirrored reflection below it. The cluster appears to turn slowly as the clip opens and keeps turning throughout. The apparent triangle rotates counter-clockwise, carrying the blue gem from the top toward the left, the lavender gem from the right toward the top, and the pink gem from the lower-left toward the lower center. The framing tightens and tilts toward a top-down angle, so side profiles give way to rounder girdle and table facets, with the pink gem reading as an oval and the blue gem as a round brilliant. Star-shaped lens-flare sparkles flicker on and off across facets, while the blurred background gems and the surface reflections shift with the turning view. Red-and-cyan chromatic fringing traces the gem edges and varies in intensity frame to frame.
